title.en: “Operating Volume Flow vs. Reference Volume Flow” leaves Diesel 40 is 2800 kg on the Diesel 40 Concrete Pump row
title.zh: 「运行 体积流量与参考 体积流量」不改柴油40上的 4108 不是柴油搅拌泵订单这一行里的「是 26 m³/h。」

description.en: Diesel 40 Concrete Pump at /products/diesel-40-concrete-pump. Diesel 40 is 2800 kg Diesel 40’s height is 1800 mm
description.zh: 柴油40上的 4108 不是柴油搅拌泵订单见 /products/diesel-40-concrete-pump。是 26 m³/h。柴油40不列搅拌电机。

h1.en: Operating Volume Flow vs. Reference Volume Flow does not retitle the Diesel 40 Concrete Pump cells
h1.zh: 「运行 体积流量与参考 体积流量」并不改写柴油40上的 4108 不是柴油搅拌泵订单的格子

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints the figures for Diesel 40 Concrete Pump. The row to open is /products/diesel-40-concrete-pump. Diesel 40 is 2800 kg. Diesel 40’s height is 1800 mm. 66–75 kW on the mixer is a range. Diesel 40 does not list a mixer motor. 3000 mm is printed on the diesel mixer. 66 kW on Diesel 40 is a single printed power. The mixer prints ≤ 1 inch, 13 mm and 24 mm as separate rows. Diesel 40’s description ties 120 m / 360 m to 1 cm aggregate. A buyer who writes only “4108” has not ordered a machine from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Diesel 40 prints 4108 / 66 kW, 26 m³/h, 25 MPa, hopper 0.4 m³, 120 m / 360 m, Kawasaki 112, 4200 × 1600 × 1800 mm and 2800 kg. The diesel mixer prints 4108 / 66–75 kW, 25 m³/h, 23 MPa, hopper 0.4 m³, three stone-distance rows, 4100 × 2200 × 3000 mm and 4200 kg. The section title “NTP - Normal Temperature and Pressure Conditions” comes from the source page and does not add a rating. No price is printed on the product page.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台印出的是柴油40上的 4108 不是柴油搅拌泵订单的数字。要打开的行是 /products/diesel-40-concrete-pump。是 26 m³/h。柴油40不列搅拌电机。柴油40是 2800 kg。柴油搅拌泵印了 3000 mm。柴油40的高度是 1800 mm。搅拌泵上的 66–75 kW 是区间。柴油40上的 66 kW 是一个印出的功率。只写“4108”并没有向河北品锦机械（邢台）订下一台机器。搅拌泵把 ≤ 1 英寸、13 mm 和 24 mm 分成不同的行。柴油40的说明把 120 m / 360 m 与 1 cm 骨料写在一起。柴油搅拌泵印 4108 / 66–75 kW、25 m³/h、23 MPa、料斗 0.4 m³、三行石子距离、4100 × 2200 × 3000 mm、4200 kg。柴油40印 4108 / 66 kW、26 m³/h、25 MPa、料斗 0.4 m³、120 m / 360 m、川崎 112、4200 × 1600 × 1800 mm、2800 kg。节标题「NTP - 标准温度与压力 条件」来自来源页，不另加额定值。产品页没有印价格。

heading.en: NTP - Normal Temperature and Pressure Conditions
heading.zh: NTP - 标准温度与压力 条件

body.en: For Diesel 40 Concrete Pump, the heading “NTP - Normal Temperature and Pressure Conditions” does not replace a cell. Diesel 40 is 2800 kg. 3000 mm is printed on the diesel mixer. A buyer who writes only “4108” has not ordered a machine from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai.
body.zh: 对柴油40上的 4108 不是柴油搅拌泵订单而言，标题「NTP - 标准温度与压力 条件」并不替换任何格子。柴油40是 2800 kg。柴油搅拌泵印了 3000 mm。只写“4108”并没有向河北品锦机械（邢台）订下一台机器。

heading.en: Operating Volume Flow vs. Reference Volume Flow
heading.zh: 运行 体积流量与参考 体积流量

body.en: Diesel 40 Concrete Pump is unchanged by the heading “Operating Volume Flow vs. Reference Volume Flow”. Diesel 40’s height is 1800 mm. 66 kW on Diesel 40 is a single printed power. Diesel 40 prints 4108 / 66 kW, 26 m³/h, 25 MPa, hopper 0.4 m³, 120 m / 360 m, Kawasaki 112, 4200 × 1600 × 1800 mm and 2800 kg.
body.zh: 柴油40上的 4108 不是柴油搅拌泵订单不因标题「运行 体积流量与参考 体积流量」而改动。柴油40的高度是 1800 mm。柴油40上的 66 kW 是一个印出的功率。柴油40印 4108 / 66 kW、26 m³/h、25 MPa、料斗 0.4 m³、120 m / 360 m、川崎 112、4200 × 1600 × 1800 mm、2800 kg。

body.en: This section is titled “Pressure Head”. Diesel 40 Concrete Pump still prints the cells below. 66–75 kW on the mixer is a range. The mixer prints ≤ 1 inch, 13 mm and 24 mm as separate rows. The diesel mixer prints 4108 / 66–75 kW, 25 m³/h, 23 MPa, hopper 0.4 m³, three stone-distance rows, 4100 × 2200 × 3000 mm and 4200 kg.
body.zh: 本节标题是「压力水头」。柴油40上的 4108 不是柴油搅拌泵订单下面这些格子仍是印出来的。搅拌泵上的 66–75 kW 是区间。搅拌泵把 ≤ 1 英寸、13 mm 和 24 mm 分成不同的行。柴油搅拌泵印 4108 / 66–75 kW、25 m³/h、23 MPa、料斗 0.4 m³、三行石子距离、4100 × 2200 × 3000 mm、4200 kg。

body.en: Under “Power”, Diesel 40 Concrete Pump contributes only the printed cells in this part. Diesel 40 does not list a mixer motor. Diesel 40’s description ties 120 m / 360 m to 1 cm aggregate. The photograph is an image from the source page https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/air-density-temperature-fan-capacity-d_144.html.
body.zh: 在「功率」下，柴油40上的 4108 不是柴油搅拌泵订单这一节只放已印出的格子。柴油40不列搅拌电机。柴油40的说明把 120 m / 360 m 与 1 cm 骨料写在一起。是 26 m³/h。配图来自来源页 https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/air-density-temperature-fan-capacity-d_144.html。

question.en: Does “NTP - Normal Temperature and Pressure Conditions” replace Diesel 40 is 2800 kg?
question.zh: 「NTP - 标准温度与压力 条件」会替换「是 26 m³/h。」吗？

answer.en: No. Diesel 40 is 2800 kg remains the printed wording for Diesel 40 Concrete Pump.
answer.zh: 不会。是 26 m³/h。仍是柴油40上的 4108 不是柴油搅拌泵订单已印的说法。

question.en: Where does Diesel 40’s height is 1800 mm belong on the Diesel 40 Concrete Pump row?
question.zh: 柴油40上的 4108 不是柴油搅拌泵订单这一行里，「柴油40不列搅拌电机。」放在哪里？

answer.en: It belongs on /products/diesel-40-concrete-pump, beside the other printed cells, not under a guessed heading.
answer.zh: 它属于 /products/diesel-40-concrete-pump，和其他已印格子在一起，不放到猜出来的标题下面。

question.en: What does “Operating Volume Flow vs. Reference Volume Flow” add to Diesel 40 Concrete Pump?
question.zh: 「运行 体积流量与参考 体积流量」给柴油40上的 4108 不是柴油搅拌泵订单增加了什么？

answer.en: It is only the section title taken from https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/air-density-temperature-fan-capacity-d_144.html. It does not add a performance figure.
answer.zh: 它只是取自 https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/air-density-temperature-fan-capacity-d_144.html 的节标题，不增加性能数字。

question.en: Is a list price printed beside Diesel 40 is 2800 kg?
